mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the eye together and using it to see the leaf was most worthwhile: the final picture connects the parts to a clear purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished eye to the body felt like a predictable assembly step, although it was needed to show the nerve route.

surprise.text: The lining and outgoing bundle have their own names: the retina and optic nerve. The picture made their connection understandable.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goal explained why the pieces belonged together.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter similarly connected familiar body parts to what they do. Seeing the light route come together was interesting, though the choices here were mostly straightforward.
